processes.name: inference gateway
processes.description: A FastAPI service that receives inference requests, forwards them to the model server, and writes requests and responses to the inference log.
processes.source_excerpt: our inference gateway, a FastAPI service on GKE
processes.notes: Keys are issued per calling team and have never been expired.

processes.name: model server
processes.description: The service that runs the actual model and reads model artifacts and customer features.
processes.source_excerpt: the model server, which runs the actual model on GPU nodes in our model network
processes.notes: I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket.

data_stores.name: model registry bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket containing model artifacts loaded by the model server at startup.
data_stores.source_excerpt: model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup
data_stores.notes: The model server uses its own service account. The description says artifact verification is not believed to occur. Push governance is uncertain: "I'm not sure what governs who can push — I think it is a shared group account."

data_stores.name: Redis feature store
data_stores.description: A Redis store containing customer features such as account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Redis feature store on the same network
data_stores.notes: Redis has no password on it; it is only reachable inside the model network.

data_stores.name: inference log
data_stores.description: A BigQuery log containing every request and response for debugging, including raw prompts.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery
data_stores.notes: Raw prompts sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed.

data_flows.notes: The model server uses its own service account for this.

trust_boundaries.description: The network containing the model server and Redis feature store; it is intended to be reachable only from the gateway.

assumptions.assumption: The inference gateway presents a web interface because it is described as a FastAPI service.
